title: Pi extension reads TOML config, with markdown as a deprecated fallback
description:
Port extensions/ticks-runner/config.ts (298 lines) to read the schema-validated TOML from tick 728, keeping every existing consumer working: resolveRunnerConfig, routeTask, taskTier, modelForTier and the planning/process-ticks/runner call sites.

Precedence: runners.toml when the structured tables are present; otherwise fall back to parsing config.md exactly as today and emit ONE deprecation warning naming the migration command — not one per section, and not per invocation of every helper. A repo that has migrated must never see the markdown path.

The parsing heuristics that exist only to compensate for markdown (extractSection, parseExecutableCommands, and the verbatim-unique matching inside parseAcceptanceEvidence) stay ONLY on the legacy path. Do not port them forward into the TOML path and do not re-derive them on top of parsed structure — the schema already guarantees what they were checking, and keeping both is how the two paths drift.

Fail-closed semantics are preserved identically on both paths: an unmapped acceptance item, an unknown command reference, or a command absent from the file fails the run rather than degrading.
